_notes: Shared rack layout: the camera, the tags and the base tag that defines the world frame. Lengths in mm, angles in deg.
World frame [U, V, W] = arm base frame: origin on the base axis at plate level, W up.
Tag frame: x along detected corner 0 -> corner 1, y 90 deg counterclockwise from x seen from above.
yaw_deg = direction of the tag's x axis in the world frame, measured from +U toward +V.
baseTag: measured t_0 (tag 0 centre -> base axis) = [-57.5, 84.5, 0] in tag 0's frame. U, V are taken parallel to tag 0's x, y, so the tag centre is at -t_0 and yaw_deg = 0.
calibrationFile is the default; the Python tools always pass the webcam calibration explicitly.
